Name: Regenerator
Effect: This Pokémon may Heal up to 4 HP or up to 2 HP in case of Lethal Damage on its own every day. In Battle this Pokémon heals 1HP at the end of each Round, up to 4HP or Lethal Damage may be healed in this manner.
Description: The body of this Pokémon will regenerate from damage really quick, wounds that would take days to heal will get better in a few hours.
